rationale: Constraints never bind with cap213 (hold +0.08-0.09 ns, <=10 slew/cap pins, 0 DRC), so only T_eff matters. Within the winning recipe (AREA 3, timing-driven placement, post-GRT timing repair, cap213) two levers look favourable: a tighter target (ocs_blitter recipe, 11.1->9 ns: 12.85->12.39) and denser placement (buffered recipe, 52%->62% density: 12.59->12.49). The unbuffered recipe beats the buffered one at similar density by ~0.15 ns. Setting 2 adds only compaction (util 48, density 64%) to the best run; setting 1 also uses the tightest target (0.45, 8.1 ns). Together they isolate the target effect and show whether the gains stack for round 4.
